title: Reference
description: Every kind, table, relation, stage and check of a product, generated from its schema and check rows.

title: Record
description: One record as `lathe show` answers it: its row, parts, children and links.

title: Problems
description: The result of a run: every problem the checks found in the loaded data, each naming its check and record. Never stored; worked out on every load.

title: Space index
description: One index per space: the records of its product and of no product (SP01), their parts, the links among them, their coverage, and the space's problems with the workspace's.

title: Folder tree
description: Each product's nav tree: Shared, then each domain's five stages, the kind groups inside a stage that holds several kinds (SP03), and the records in them, placed by DS03.

title: Graph map
description: One map per product and layout: the folder tree (DS04) laid out once per load by DS05 (Tree), DS07 (Nested) or DS08 (Voronoi), every node with its place, size and label.

title: ERD
description: What a product's, a domain's or an aggregate's ERD draws, with the focus's nearest entity or aggregate highlighted: boxes and lines, worked out on each request.

title: Record history
description: The commits that changed a record's rows, read from git on each request.

title: Spaces
description: Every product as a space in the rail, with its look and place.

title: Workspace
description: Every product's records, links, problems and coverage, as one load of the data files gives them: `Workspace` in `lathe/src/types.ts`. Filled from the data files whenever they change.

title: Keymap
description: Every keyboard command with its bindings as the platform shows them, which every hint, the palette and the sheet read.

title: Themes
description: Every theme, which one is in use and the color mode.

title: Recent folders
description: The recent folders, latest first, as File › Open Recent and the Dock menu list them.

title: Claude Code sessions
description: A folder's saved Claude Code sessions, from the CLI's own session store, each with its title, when it was last written, and whether another Claude client may have it open.

title: Reader's view
description: What a window shows the Reader: its page, the focused record, the stage, the record selected on the stage or in the wiki card, and whether the wiki card is open.

title: Coverage
description: Per domain and obligation kind: how many obligations are designed, built, proved and not automated yet, out of the total; and per obligation, the tests that count as its proof there.

title: Coverage gaps
description: Each obligation not designed, built or proved, with what it lacks.

title: Tests by state
description: Each domain's tests by state: automated, manual and not automated yet.

title: Owed pattern rules
description: Each pattern rule each following domain owes, with its standing there.

title: File facts
description: Each test and technical record that names a file: whether the file exists, and whether a test's file names its ID. With them, each endpoint's and view's route and whether the files of what implements it name it, and each route the code serves.

title: Record trace
description: The records that design, build and prove one record, by group.

title: Table facts
description: Each part a table kept in a database should have in the file it names (the table, each column, each primary, unique and foreign key), and whether that file defines it.
